Many buses don\'t report where they are. Riders can: with buttons on the follow notification, or automatically from their phone while riding. Only the bus, the stop and the time are sent, with a random ID that changes for every bus. Never your location.
While you wait for a bus you follow, the app uses your location to work out the walk to the stop and tells you when to leave. Your location stays on this phone.
You can change both later in Account > Community and location.

Plan&Ride collects location data to show “Will I catch it?” and to mark where your bus is in Automatic mode, even when the app is closed or not in use. This happens only while you follow a bus, with a notification shown the whole time.
“Allow all the time” lets this work for regular rides that start by themselves. Your location stays on this phone and is never sent or shared.

• Blue is back: Zastávka is the default theme again, with a slate bottom bar and a blue P&R icon (EM-0056). The green themes stay in Account → Appearance.
• The bottom bar always fits the screen; opening a tab no longer squeezes the last icon (EM-0052).
• The followed bus on Home has a softly moving background in your theme's colour.
• Follow the whole journey: the button now shows when the journey is followed, and stops it with a tap (EM-0055).
• A bus's stops show where you get on, not only where you get off (EM-0057).
• Reporting a bug: your name and email are filled in once the app is unlocked, also for a report you started while it was locked (EM-0058).
• Following a bus: when it reaches a stop, the notification says you're at that stop, not at the one before (EM-0059).
